description: Find broken links (404 errors) on https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. STEPS: 1) Enter 'https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links' in the URL bar and press Enter to start crawling. 2) Wait for crawl to complete. 3) Click on the 'Response Codes' tab in the left panel to view status codes. 4) Look for rows showing '404' or 'Client Error (4xx)' - these are broken links. SUCCESS CRITERIA: You must identify at least one 404 error from crawler-test.com. Optionally export the results using Bulk Export > Response Codes > Client Error (4xx) to CSV.
